disclaimer.title: General guidance, not medical advice
disclaimer.body: JoyoRogo is not a medical device. The numbers here follow Indonesia's AKG 2019 (Permenkes 28/2019) and the IOM 2009 guidelines, and they do not replace your doctor or midwife. Follow the advice of the health professional who sees you.
disclaimer.kia: Keep your check-ups in the KIA book (Buku KIA) and see Posyandu, the puskesmas, or your midwife regularly.
disclaimer.short: Not a medical device. Follow your doctor or midwife.

privacy.note: Your pregnancy and breastfeeding details are only visible to you. Nothing is shared to groups, the feed, or public pages.

entry.question: Pregnant or breastfeeding?
entry.hint: We adjust your calorie and nutrient targets for this time: no deficit and no weight-loss target. You can change it any time in Profile.
entry.pregnantHint: Week and trimester are worked out for you

dateKind.hphtHint: First day of your last period

date.hphtHelp: We work out your pregnancy week from this date, and it updates every day.
date.hplHelp: The due date from your doctor or midwife, for example from an ultrasound. Your pregnancy week is counted back from it.

preWeight.label: Weight before pregnancy
preWeight.hint: In kg. It is the basis of your energy needs and your weight-gain range.
preWeight.hintOptional: Optional. If empty, we use your current weight.

currentWeight.label: Your weight now
currentWeight.hint: In kg. It becomes your first weigh-in.

feeding.label: How you breastfeed
feeding.partialHint: Breast milk plus formula or solids

conditions.title: Any known conditions?
conditions.optional: Optional. It only adds a reminder to check with your doctor and does not change the numbers.

error.weight: Enter your weight before pregnancy, between 25 and 250 kg.
error.female: This mode is only for female profiles.

target.title: What you need today
target.baseHint: Before pregnancy, from your starting weight, height, age, and activity
target.noDeficit: No calorie cut and no weight target while this mode is on.
target.reached: You've covered what you need today

needs.addBody: The energy addition from AKG 2019 (Permenkes 28/2019) for this stage.
needs.baseBody: Daily energy to hold your weight, from your weight before pregnancy, height, age, and activity.
needs.noDeficit: No calorie cut and no weight target while this mode is on.

nutrients.title: Your daily nutrients
nutrients.source: Numbers from AKG 2019 (Permenkes 28/2019), including the addition for this stage.
nutrients.guidanceNote: Foods in JoyoRogo don't record these nutrients yet, so this is guidance only, not a number we calculate from your meals.

protein.name: Protein
protein.hint: Well-cooked eggs, fish, chicken, tempeh, tofu, legumes.

fiber.name: Fiber
fiber.hint: Vegetables, fruit, legumes, brown rice. It helps digestion.

water.name: Water
water.hint: This AKG 2019 figure includes water from food and other drinks; your glass goal is rounded from it. Log your glasses on the Water card.

iron.name: Iron
iron.hint: Red meat, fish, well-cooked eggs, tempeh, spinach. Vitamin C helps absorption. Ask your midwife or doctor about iron tablets.

folate.name: Folate
folate.hint: Leafy greens, legumes, citrus, well-cooked eggs. Follow your doctor's or midwife's advice on folic acid supplements.

calcium.name: Calcium
calcium.hint: Pasteurized or UHT milk, yogurt, anchovies, tofu, tempeh, leafy greens.

iodine.name: Iodine
iodine.hint: Iodized salt, sea fish, well-cooked eggs, milk.

vitaminA.name: Vitamin A
vitaminA.hint: Carrots, pumpkin, sweet potato, leafy greens, well-cooked eggs. Avoid high-dose vitamin A supplements unless your doctor says so.

dha.name: DHA (omega-3)
dha.hint: Well-cooked, low-mercury sea fish such as mackerel, anchovies, sardines, salmon. At least 200 mg DHA a day is recommended (FAO/WHO 2010).

gain.subtitle: Compared with your weight before pregnancy
gain.total: IOM 2009 advice for the whole pregnancy: {{min}} to {{max}} kg
gain.totalTwins: IOM 2009 advice for twins (provisional): {{min}} to {{max}} kg
gain.rate: Trimesters 2 and 3, on average {{min}} to {{max}} kg per week
gain.current: Up {{gain}} kg at week {{week}}. This week's range is {{min}} to {{max}} kg.
gain.empty: Weigh in to start seeing your gain chart.
gain.chartLabel: Chart of weight gain by pregnancy week against the recommended range

status.within: Your weight gain is inside the recommended range for this week.
status.below: Your weight gain is a little under the range for this week. That isn't necessarily a problem; mention it to your doctor or midwife at your next visit.
status.above: Your weight gain is a little above the range for this week. Don't cut back on eating on your own; talk to your doctor or midwife first.

gain.source: Source: IOM 2009. The line between weeks is our interpolation between 0.5 to 2 kg at the end of trimester 1 and the total at term.

flags.title: A note for you
flags.footer: This is a reminder, not a ban or medical advice. If you're unsure, ask your doctor or midwife.

alcohol.title: Contains alcohol
alcohol.body: It's safer to have no alcohol while pregnant or breastfeeding. If it already happened, no need to panic; tell your doctor or midwife if you're worried.

caffeine.title: Contains caffeine
caffeine.body: About {{mg}} mg of caffeine per serving. The commonly advised daily limit is 200 mg, around two cups of coffee.

flags.caffeineDay: Caffeine today is about {{mg}} mg of the {{limit}} mg limit
flags.caffeineOver: Caffeine today is already about {{mg}} mg, over the {{limit}} mg daily limit. You can ease off gently tomorrow.

rawMeat.title: Meat not fully cooked
rawMeat.body: Raw or undercooked meat can carry bacteria and parasites, including toxoplasma. Ask for it to be cooked through.

rawEgg.title: Eggs not fully cooked
rawEgg.body: Raw or runny eggs carry a salmonella risk. Cook until the yolk and white are firm.

rawFish.title: Raw fish or shellfish
rawFish.body: Sushi, sashimi, and raw seafood are best avoided during pregnancy. Choose cooked options.

mercuryFish.title: High-mercury fish
mercuryFish.body: Shark, swordfish, marlin, and fresh tuna are high in mercury. Choose other fish such as mackerel, cooked salmon, or canned tuna in moderation.

unpasteurized.title: Unpasteurized milk or cheese
unpasteurized.body: Unpasteurized products can carry listeria. Choose ones labelled pasteurized or UHT.

herbal.title: Jamu or herbal remedy
herbal.body: Not every jamu is proven safe for pregnant or breastfeeding women. Ask your doctor or midwife before drinking it.

notes.TWINS_ENERGY: Twin pregnancy: AKG has no twin-specific addition, so we use the singleton pregnancy figure. You may need more; ask your doctor or dietitian.
notes.PARTIAL_ESTIMATE: Partial breastfeeding: AKG has no figure of its own. We use the full AKG addition as an estimate; your need may be a little lower if your baby also has formula or solids. Ask your doctor or midwife if you're unsure.
notes.OVERDUE: Your HPHT is more than 42 weeks ago. Please check the date, or choose Had my baby if your baby has been born.
notes.BABY_OVER_12: AKG only covers babies up to 12 months. We keep using the month 7 to 12 figures.
notes.TWINS_UNDERWEIGHT: For twins with an underweight start, IOM has no official range. We show the normal-weight twin range as a reference; ask your doctor.
notes.CONSULT: You noted a condition. The numbers here are general guidance; follow the advice of the doctor or midwife who monitors you.
notes.gestational_diabetes: Gestational diabetes: carbohydrate planning should be discussed with your doctor or dietitian.
notes.hypertension: Hypertension or preeclampsia: keep an eye on your blood pressure and follow your doctor's advice, including on salt.
notes.anemia: Anemia: ask your doctor or midwife about iron tablets and iron-rich foods.

settings.title: Pregnancy and breastfeeding
settings.rowOff: Set this up if you're pregnant or breastfeeding
settings.intro: Your target has no deficit and no weight loss: your daily need plus the AKG 2019 addition for your stage.
settings.turnOffBody: Your target goes back to a standard daily need, with no weight loss. If you later want to lose weight, talk to your doctor or midwife first, then set the target in Profile.
settings.hiddenNote: Weight target, target date, fasting, and streaks are hidden while this mode is on.
settings.ramadanNote: Pregnant and breastfeeding women may skip the fast. The automatic Ramadan schedule isn't used for you; talk to your doctor or religious teacher if you want to fast.

end.title: Had your baby?
end.body: We hope you and your baby are well. Pick what fits, and your target will adjust.
end.noneHint: Back to a standard daily need

postpartum.title: After birth
postpartum.body: Your body needs time to recover, so there is no weight-loss target here. If you later want to lose weight, talk to your doctor or midwife first, then set a gentle target in Profile.
postpartum.check: Go to your postnatal check-up and note it in the KIA book.
